baseline.name: NodeReadiness
NodeDirectoryEntry
baseline.sdl:
# Fleet-discovery directory: one row per (source DID, node DID), maintained by
# the directory projection reconciler (modeled in
# Proofs/PeerRegistryDiscovery/DirectoryProjection.lean). Pure derived state,
# rebuildable from Node x Agent x NodeReadiness; a row grants nothing —
# discovery is not a privilege boundary. `@branchable` is required: the
# machine template replicates this collection to attached clients.
type NodeDirectoryEntry @branchable {
    # Deterministic hash of (source_did, node_did); DefraDB unique indexes are
    # per-field, so this is the persisted source-partitioned identity.
    directory_key: String @index(unique: true) @immutable
    node_did: String @index
    # Runtime that derived this row; machine replication filters on it.
    # @immutable is required by defradb replication-filter fields and is
    # semantically half of the directory_key identity hash.
    source_did: String @index @immutable
    display_name: String
    # Agent display names and ids (index-aligned) for the picker; emitted as
    # null, never [], when empty.
    agents: [String]
    agent_ids: [String]
    # Resolved from Node.default_agent_id; empty when the node has none.
    default_agent_id: String
    runtime_state: String @index
    last_seen: DateTime
    updated_at: DateTime @index(direction: DESC)
}

baseline.name: AgentRequest
baseline.sdl:
type AgentRequest @branchable {
    request_id: String @index @immutable
    purpose: String @index @immutable
    node_did: String @index @immutable
    requester_did: String @index @immutable
    admission_kind: String @index @immutable
    admission_signer_did: String @index @immutable
    admission_signature: String @immutable
    enrollment_request_id: String @index @immutable
    enrollment_request_digest: String @immutable
    enrollment_admin_did: String @index @immutable
    enrollment_authorization_sequence: Int @immutable
    enrollment_authorization_expires_at: String @index @immutable
    runtime_issuer_did: String @index @immutable
    runtime_source_request_id: String @index @immutable
    runtime_source_kind: String @index @immutable
    agent_id: String @index @immutable
    session_id: String @index @immutable
    retry_parent_request: String @immutable
    retry_parent_request_doc_id: String @index @immutable
    retry_root_request: String @immutable
    retry_key: String @index(unique: true) @immutable
    superseded_by_request: String
    superseded_by_request_doc_id: String @index
    content: String @immutable
    # Execution-owner aggregate budget from InferenceExecution, not a caller
    # override; consumed tokens rehydrate from InferenceCall records. First
    # claim writes this pin; later claims preserve it via the execution
    # generation CAS. Cannot be immutable at document creation.
    max_total_tokens: Int
    # RequestInput invocation facts as canonical strict JSON; encode empty
    # nillable lists as null, decode with unknown keys failing.
    input: JSON @immutable
    lifecycle_state: String @index
    backend_id: String @index
    execution_origin: String @immutable
    caused_by_trigger_id: String @index @immutable
    caused_by_trigger_doc_id: String @index @immutable
    caused_by_trigger_kind: String @index @immutable
    caused_by_correlation: String @index @immutable
    caused_by_trigger_context: String @immutable
    caused_by_source_doc_id: String @index @immutable
    failure_reason: String
    terminalized_at: String @index
    # Runtime-owned TerminalOutput: message {message_doc_id} or no_message.
    # Written with terminal lifecycle, then never changed. Missing on a
    # terminal replica means incomplete, never implicit no_message. Excluded
    # from requester signatures.
    terminal_output: JSON
    # Terminal-owner certificate: interrupted while still Claimed, before the
    # Processing fence. Missing or false is unknown.
    stopped_before_running: Boolean
    terminal_redrive_attempts: Int @index
    created_at: String @index @immutable
    claimed_at: String
    # Runtime-owned execution lease (#1571). Claim installs a fresh generation,
    # lease length and the claim's own deadline; the owning runtime alone
    # decides expiry and renews explicitly at bounded cadence. Renewal compares
    # generation and observed deadline; decisions keep the matching-generation
    # CAS without implicit renewal. Tool-owned output never renews the parent.
    execution_generation: String @index
    execution_lease_secs: Int
    execution_lease_expires_at: String @index
    background_completion_input_through_sequence: Int
    background_completion_notification_keys_json: String
    # Bumped by every background admission so concurrent slot checks conflict.
    background_admission_sequence: Int
    # Runtime-derived execution deadline; excluded from requester signatures.
    deadline: String
    retry_count: Int @immutable
    max_retries: Int @immutable
    interrupt_requested_at: String
    valid_until: String @immutable
    # Session-message lineage, filled only on agent_new/agent_message calls or
    # a request-only control continuation; null on roots. request_hop null
    # means hop 0; an explicitly configured Node.max_request_hop caps admission.
    request_hop: Int @immutable
    caused_by_parent_request_id: String @index @immutable
    caused_by_parent_request_doc_id: String @index @immutable
    caused_by_parent_tool_call_id: String @index @immutable
    caused_by_parent_tool_call_doc_id: String @index @immutable
    workspace_id: String @index @immutable
    # Signed node scope of workspace_id, not host/deployment identity.
    workspace_owner_node_did: String @index @immutable
    workspace_authority: String @immutable
    workspace_seal_hash: String @immutable
}

# closing record and assistant header before dispatch. An
# agent_new/agent_message call is a background row: the request it causes
# names this row through caused_by_parent_tool_call_doc_id, and that request's
# terminal output terminalizes the row and notifies this session.
type AgentToolCall @branchable {

    status: String

    lifecycle_state: String @index
    started_at: DateTime

    completed_at: DateTime
    terminal_output: JSON

baseline.name: RenderedRequest
baseline.sdl:
# Durable fact record for one provider call: the exact rendered request,
# persisted before it is sent. Proofs/RenderedCapture.lean fences the order —
# a send is legal only after the matching (capture_key, canonical request) is
# durable. `@branchable` is deliberate and irreversible; it is the bulk-backfill
# and collection-scoped-ACP precondition, not the content address: integrity
# comes from the DefraDB field commit CID for `request_json`. Capture payloads are
# manifests of RenderedRequestBlock references; the two collections are one
# sync unit. No `@policy` and no encryption: rows on this node remain
# anonymously readable, so #840's participant boundary is NOT met as shipped.
type RenderedRequest @branchable @index(fields: ["node_did", "requester_did", "session_id", "source", "capture_scope", "created_at"]) {
    # sha256 over the canonical (node_did, session_id, request_scope,
    # turn_index, attempt) tuple. Unique: exactly one capture per provider
    # attempt, ever; reuse with a different canonical request is an integrity
    # error, never an update.
    capture_key: String @index(unique: true) @immutable
    # Exact DefraDB `_docID` of the durable AgentRequest; empty for one-shot runs.
    request_doc_id: String @index @immutable
    # Composite DefraDB commit CID current when this capture was durably
    # persisted; empty only for one-shot runs.
    request_commit_cid: String @index @immutable
    request_id: String @index @immutable
    session_id: String @index @immutable
    node_did: String @index @immutable
    requester_did: String @immutable
    agent_id: String @immutable
    # Which completion loop inside the request issued this provider call
    # (inference.N, compaction.N, compaction_fallback.N, title.N, oneshot.N).
    capture_scope: String @immutable
    # The owned completion loop's turn and retry counters.
    turn_index: Int @immutable
    attempt: Int @immutable
    # Capture format version; selects the request and provenance readers.
    capture_version: Int @immutable
    model_name: String @immutable
    # Provider wire shape the request was sent on, derived from the request
    # path the transport actually posted to.
    source: String @immutable
    # Versioned container (v1: canonical provider JSON) for the provider body
    # and heavy native provenance. The decoded value is the conformance oracle;
    # every logical-record delta pins the same physical field commit on its
    # immutable base document.
    request_json: String @immutable
    # Versioned provenance manifest; absent required provenance reads as
    # CapturedOnly, never as evidence of reconstructibility.
    provenance_json: String @immutable
    created_at: DateTime @index @immutable
}

baseline.name: RenderedRequestBlock
baseline.sdl:
# Immutable capture or reduction content, or an ordered manifest of child
# references. Captures, provider-context reductions and their blocks are one
# sync unit: a manifest without its blocks is undecodable and a block without a
# referencing manifest is inert, so neither is delivered, backed up or pruned
# without the other. `@branchable` is deliberate and irreversible. `content_key` (sha256
# over the payload bytes) is dedupe/lookup only, never integrity evidence:
# integrity rides on the DefraDB field commit CID of `payload`, pinned in the
# referencing manifest and re-checked at read time. A reference never broadens
# access: reading a capture's body means reading every block it names. Blocks
# dedupe across every agent, session and DID; once per-DID ACP applies to
# captures, that scope must become per-node. Indexes are deliberately few:
# blocks are the highest-volume collection.
type RenderedRequestBlock @branchable {
    content_key: String @index(unique: true) @immutable
    # UTF-8 content bytes or encoded child references, never rewritten.
    # The capture tree height distinguishes leaves from manifest nodes.
    payload: String @immutable
    # Left unset: DefraDB derives the document id from the fields written, so
    # deleted block documents can never be recreated with the same bytes.
    byte_len: Int @immutable
    created_at: String @immutable
}

baseline.name: ProviderContextReduction
baseline.sdl:
# Immutable request-local provider-context reduction fact, deliberately
# separate from CompactionEntry: a sticky provider projection inside one
# AgentRequest, never part of cumulative session-prefix dropping. Payload
# fields contain prompt material and have RenderedRequest's local audit-only
# placement: no @policy or encryption claim — the pinned EmbeddedNode cannot
# install document ACP and Defra field encryption does not encrypt the local
# datastore. Runtime catalogs exclude this collection from bulk-sync routes.
type ProviderContextReduction @branchable {
    # SHA-256 of [node_did, session_id, request_doc_id, turn_index,
    # reduction_index]. Ordinary indexed, not unique: the runtime
    # create-and-compare owner fails closed if more than one fact binds this key.
    reduction_key: String @index @immutable
    node_did: String @index @immutable
    requester_did: String @index @immutable
    session_id: String @index @immutable
    request_id: String @index @immutable
    request_doc_id: String @index @immutable
    request_commit_cid: String @immutable
    reduction_index: Int @index @immutable
    turn_index: Int @index @immutable
    parent_reduction_key: String @index @immutable
    producer_call_id: String @index @immutable
    producer_call_seq: Int @immutable
    # Versioned boundary containing the exact AgentRequest claim commit and
    # the newest canonical AgentMessage visible when reduction began.
    source_boundary_json: String @immutable
    # Exact pair-safe split of the source native provider projection; their
    # concatenation is the source view. Each value is an inline JSON array or
    # a pinned manifest of RenderedRequestBlocks.
    compacted_prefix_json: String @immutable
    retained_suffix_json: String @immutable
    pair_closed: Boolean @immutable
    # Versioned exact rendered prefix; the provider projection appends the
    # retained suffix. Existing full-array checkpoint values remain readable.
    checkpoint_messages_json: String @immutable
    # Canonical provider-source tags aligned to the prefix/suffix projection.
    replay_associations_json: String @immutable
    summary: String @immutable
    messages_compacted: Int @immutable
    original_tokens: Int @immutable
    compacted_tokens: Int @immutable
    created_at: DateTime @index @immutable
}

# Frozen origin and an append-only journal for one configuration optimization
# job (#1455). Local-only: the journal carries candidate system prompts.
# `origin` and `journal` are Strings holding serialized JSON: a JSON column
# decodes numbers as f64 and would not round-trip u64 budgets above 2^53.
type OptimizationJob @index(fields: ["owner_node_did", "job_id"], unique: true) {
    job_id: String @immutable
    owner_node_did: String @index @immutable
    origin: String @immutable
    journal: String
    journal_len: Int
    state: String @index
    created_at: String @index @immutable
}
